rules.statement: When a mortgage decree directs the sale of mortgaged property and provides for enforcement in default, section 347 of the Civil Procedure Code does not apply.
rules.supporting_quote: In the case of such a decree as this, there is really no place for the Fiscal. No demand need be made for there is already direction in the decree itself that the sale shall take place 'in default of payment forthwith', nor is the Fiscal required in order to effect seizure and sale, for an auctioneer has been appointed to carry out the sale.
